note: Private campground near Milford on 100 acres with three ponds (two stocked for fishing), a swimming area, enclosed pavilion, general store and planned weekend activities. Mostly long-stay: summer imagery shows most sites set up with trailers, decks and sheds, and seasonal stays come with an association membership; nightly sites are sold alongside them. --Claude
summary: Operator site (home, pricing, about, service pages) read; Google 4.7/34; no gateway. $30 W/E nightly under the gate. Season 04-01 -> 04-15 (operator's window). Looks mostly seasonal on imagery; nightly share not measurable. Not waterfront kept. Pin OK.
flags: LONG-STAY (reviewer): five tests - (1) nightly sold to the public: yes, $30 posted, 'Call to Reserve'; (2) posted rate: yes but undated (site footer 2021); (3) no wording discouraging nightly guests ('Whether you are looking for seasonal, monthly, weekly or daily camping we can accommodate you'); (4) occupancy: summer Esri imagery shows ~60-70 of the ~95 sites holding set-up trailers, many with decks and sheds - looks mostly seasonal, nightly share NOT measurable (no site map, no site count on the operator site); (5) Google 4.7 from 34 reviews, RV Life 4 stars. Seasonal stays carry 'MEMBERSHIP TO ASSOCIATION & CAMPGROUND'. Mostly seasonal but not clearly iffy (posted rate, good reviews) -> keep with the mostly-seasonal note unless the reviewer rules otherwise.
PRICE GATE: $30 W/E nightly, under $50; gateways.py: none within 40 km (not needed).

SEASON: stored opens 04-01 -> 04-15. The pricing page's only dates are the seasonal window 'APRIL 15TH THROUGH OCOBER 31ST'; the stored inclusion_evidence quoted 'open Apr 1-Oct 31' from the same page, which no longer says so.
SITES: count 95 (note-derived) left as stored - the operator site gives no site count.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Some units on the NE shore of the central pond (~40.5953,-87.7783) sit within ~20 m of the water, but no site numbers or map exist, the pond is ~70 m wide, and those units look like seasonal set-ups; nothing earns an upgrade.
